tasks.prompt:

Input is an array of {eventId, account, delta}. Duplicate eventId records are identical duplicate deliveries; count each eventId once. Sum integer delta per account. Return [[account,balance],...] sorted by account using ordinary lexicographic string order. Accounts can be any strings, including object prototype names.

function solve(input) {
  const byEvent = Object.create(null);
  const balances = Object.create(null);

    const eventId = rec.eventId;

  result.sort((a,b)=> a[0] < b[0] ? -1 : a[0] > b[0] ? 1 : 0);

}
